invented_facts: The Aurora 14 can reduce the firm's cloud workstation costs; the source provides no cost comparison.
Cloud workstation use adds a monthly bill to every seat, and the firm's data stays in the office.
Engineers can access client files offline and process drawings and project files on the Aurora 14 without sending them to the cloud; those workflows are not established by the spec sheet.
Client drawings and project files never leave the device unless the firm authorizes it.
The Aurora 14 will keep engineers productive during connectivity failures.
Storage is user-upgradeable; the spec sheet specifies two M.2 slots but only explicitly calls memory user-upgradeable.
Ordering now positions the firm for deployment when its new budget cycle opens.
notes: All three emails have a subject and one CTA, and they follow the requested sequence. Emails 1 and 2 exceed 120 words, while several central cost, security and offline-work claims go beyond the supplied facts.
